support_claim: Unresolved-preservation evidence blocks closure because no proposition establishes identity or distinctness between billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and registry:3840192, and an alternate registry candidate remains live.

propositions.proposition: Sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics", while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Documents multiple name variants associated with the Northbridge counterparty; name alignment alone does not establish identity between billing and registry referents.

propositions.proposition: A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC".
propositions.relevance: Introduces an additional registry entity as a live candidate, preventing closure on a single contracting party.

propositions.proposition: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.
propositions.relevance: Explicitly records that identity between billing referent and any specific registry entity cannot be established.

propositions.proposition: The registry link should be treated as unresolved.
propositions.relevance: Directly preserves unresolved status for the candidate identity relation between billing and registry referents.

propositions.proposition: Registry record 3840192 lists the entity as "NORTHBRIDGE ANALYTICS INC" in Delaware with status active.
propositions.relevance: Identifies what registry:3840192 denotes; name similarity to the billing name is present but does not by itself establish identity.

propositions.proposition: Billing invoices record the billed name as "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Corroborates the billing-side referent name but does not link it to registry:3840192.
